summary.text: Dan Wolgamott is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 14B.

The House member page lists his occupation as coach, says he was first elected in 2018, and lists committee assignments including Higher Education Finance and Policy and the Legislative Commission on Pensions and Retirement.

paragraphs.text: His education is listed as a B.A. in political science from The College of Saint Benedict/St. John's University, and his family as two children.

sources.title: Rep. Dan Wolgamott (14B) - Minnesota House of Representatives
